component.name: Memi
component.summary: Notes on the people in your life

description.p: Memi keeps the specific, useful things you learn about the people in your life: the gift idea someone mentioned in passing, the plan you made over coffee, the allergy you don't want to forget.

ul.li: Every person gets their own categories, like Gift ideas, Plans and Notes
Categories can build up to a birthday, an anniversary or a trip, and show what's due as the day gets close
Still fresh brings back what you added recently and what's coming up
Mark ideas as a hit or a miss once they're done
Five colour schemes, each in light and dark

description.p: Everything stays on your computer. If you want your phone and computer to stay in step, sync keeps an end-to-end encrypted copy in your own Google Drive, which only your devices can read. There are no accounts, no ads and no tracking. The privacy policy is at yourmemi.app/privacy.

screenshot.caption: Your people, what's coming up, and one person's categories
Dark mode and the theme panel

description.p: The apps now match each other. On Android you can remove a person's photo. The web app can reorder people, categories and notes from their menus, place a photo in its frame, and remind you of birthdays.
Choose each person's colour from their menu, from your theme's eight person colours. On Android, pressing and holding to open a menu no longer also opens the item.

The first full release. Sync can now go to your own WebDAV server (such as Nextcloud) or a folder that Syncthing or Dropbox keeps in step, as well as Google Drive. You can save and open backup files, people get their own colour, saving is much quicker with a lot in Memi, and screen readers can find their way around.
Sync is easier to find: Home now shows whether you're synced, and one click opens Sync. The palette button is now Settings.

A new device now asks whether you've used Memi before, so it can pick up from your other devices in a couple of steps, or start fresh with or without sync. Memi also has a brighter icon, and is called Memi everywhere. Underneath, Memi on Android, Windows, Linux and the web now runs on one shared engine, and its security code uses established, audited libraries.
Your devices now stay in step on their own, and every edit is kept: Memi merges changes item by item instead of keeping only the latest copy.

ul.li: Start on any device: a new one asks your other devices for the key, and you allow it with a six-digit code
Memi in your browser at memi.yourmemi.app
Optional birthday reminders, on the day, the day before or a week before
Drag people, categories and notes into your own order
Coming up shows the next three birthdays, dated categories and plans; Still fresh can be folded away

description.p: Lost your recovery key? You can now start sync over from the Sync screen. Memi makes a new key and a fresh backup from what's on this device, and your other devices ask for the new key.

ul.li: A device that still has the old key no longer overwrites a backup it can't open
The AppImage can update itself with Gear Lever or AppImageUpdate
Downloads keep the same file names, so links always get the newest version

description.p: The first release for Linux and Windows, rebuilt from the ground up.
